headline: On November 18, 2026: Voyager 1 crosses one light-day mark from Earth
captionCards: Still communicating with Earth via NASA's Deep Space Network
instagramCaption:
Voyager 1 becomes first human-made object to travel a full light day from Earth.

Launched in 1977, it reached 173.02 AU by November 2026. On November 18, 2026, it crossed one light-day distance—about 18 trillion kilometers—from Earth. NASA invited people to 'Shine Bright for Voyager' the day before, flashing VGR in Morse code.

It remains humanity’s farthest-reaching artifact, symbolizing enduring exploration.
